lines: {target}? Black stone and lava leave little mercy. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Basalt Deltas, tell them: Step like every block wants an argument. I will be at the stonecutter.
Ash and basalt make the Nether feel broken twice. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Basalt Deltas is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Basalt Deltas as as jagged black country with heat in its cracks. I will keep spare blocks close.
